channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bob McAdoo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bob McAdoo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Bob McAdoo, James Harden
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Mike D'Antoni on coaching James Harden:

“I remember when I went and told him he was going to run the offense as the point guard I'm sure he was channeling his inner Bob McAdoo and thought coach just give me the effing ball. He's one of the most skilled players I've ever coached, and I appreciate the trust he gave me. Thank you, James”

Mike D'Antoni on Bob McAdoo, James Harden, Aug 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Bob McAdoo
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard, on tying Bob McAdoo’s single-season franchise record:

“Amazing. Thank god for being able to play consistently this year and be able to be in that conversation of the greats that used to play this game.”

Kawhi Leonard on Bob McAdoo, Mar 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Robert Parish, Bob McAdoo
item.description:
“I wasn’t even as good as Chief [Robert Parish]. I was not even as good as Bob McAdoo. For people to say ‘Hey, Shaquille O’Neal, you’re great,’ I didn’t do it by myself. I did it with all these guys.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Robert Parish, Bob McAdoo, Feb 21, 2022. Source: Wall Street Journal.
